known_gray_zone.note: `_sort_key` orders nodes by the repr of `(type(node).__name__, str(node))`, so heterogeneous or numeric nodes are compared as strings and sort lexicographically (e.g. '10' before '9'); a reviewer might flag this as a surprising, non-numeric tie-break. It is not one of the injected defects.
